# Filter the invitation messages to those sent this week (May 15-21, 2023)
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Current date from earlier: Thursday, May 18, 2023
current_date = datetime(2023, 5, 18)
# Monday of this week
monday = current_date - timedelta(days=current_date.weekday())  # weekday() Monday=0
sunday = monday + timedelta(days=6)

invitation_messages = []
for m in messages:
    if "splitwise group invitation" in m["message"]:
        sent_date = datetime.strptime(m["sent_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
        if monday <= sent_date <= sunday:
            invitation_messages.append(m)

print(f"Found {len(invitation_messages)} invitation messages this week")
for m in invitation_messages:
    print(m["text_message_id"], m["sender"]["phone_number"], m["message"])
